newsitem.title: FRANCE: Strike keeps Louvre museum closed for fourth day.
newsitem.headline: Strike keeps Louvre museum closed for fourth day.

text.p: A strike by guards closed France's Louvre museum for a fourth day on Sunday, disappointing thousands of art lovers.
About 30 strikers maintained a picket outside the glass and steel pyramid that forms the entrance of the museum, home to masterpieces including the Mona Lisa and the Venus de Milo.

Strikers stuck white posters on the pyramid saying "strike" in both French and English. The guards, who work the night shift in the museum, are demanding 28 nights off a year instead of 26 offered by management.

Management accuses the pickets of taking tourists and art lovers hostage, noting that they represent only a fraction of the 1,000 or so guards in the giant museum. The Louvre has about 18,000 visitors a day in May.
